answers.core:
Having this implemented in the engine makes performance troubleshooting easier, without requiring the installation of third-party add-ons or overlays.

Ensuring your 1% lows are high as possible can make the difference between an unplayable and playable game, so it's important to ensure that this is a metric developers optimize for in their games.
answers.workaround: No. This can be implemented with a GDScript add-on, but see the remark below about engine integration and performance mindset.

title: Add an Engine method and Performance monitor to return the 1% low FPS ("99th percentile")
